📖 How to use

  1. Enter your base salary.
  2. Enter the employer-paid health insurance value per year.
  3. Enter your contribution %, the employer match rate %, and the match cap % to compute the match dollars.
  4. Enter PTO days and other perks, then read your total compensation.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the employer match computed?

The match applies to your contribution up to the cap: salary times the smaller of your contribution % and the cap %, times the match rate %.

How is PTO valued?

Each PTO day is valued at salary divided by 260 working days.

What counts as other perks?

Anything with a cash value: transit passes, wellness stipends, tuition help, free meals. Enter the yearly total.
